methodology.title: Methods and limits
methodology.lead: This page records where the numbers come from and what they do not mean.
methodology.analysisLead: Situation category, skill overlap and adjacent occupations are calculated with documented weights. AI may parse tasks; it does not invent official figures or the final similarity score.
methodology.weights: Career-bridge weights live in one place: src/lib/scoring/weights.ts.
methodology.bandsLead: The offline scorer uses these bands, calibrated for Finnish working life. The rubric and its version live in src/lib/scoring/prompt.ts.
methodology.fixturesLead: Without an API key the catalog carries only these labelled rows. Every other occupation stays unscored and is never given a guessed value.
methodology.compositionLead: The view summary computes official shares from every occupation in view and AI estimates from the scored ones only. Coverage is always stated before any mean, because the scored subset is not a random sample.
methodology.regionalLead: The barometer's public JSON returns observations per region. Regional rows are shown as they stand, and figures subject to secrecy stay missing.
methodology.whatBody: Ammattialtistus describes theoretical AI exposure, observed adoption and labour-market matching for the occupations in Classification of Occupations 2010. Exposure is an estimate of the nature of the tasks. It is not a forecast of redundancies, of automation, or of an occupation disappearing.
methodology.sourceEmployment: Statistics Finland, employment, table {tableId}, year {year}, updated {updated}.
methodology.sourceAggregation: The aggregation rule as stored in the dataset: {rule}
methodology.mappingNote: The full mapping and the per-field schemas are in docs/SOURCE_DATA_MAPPING.md.
methodology.notOfficialBody: The AI exposure and adoption scores are not statistics from Statistics Finland, the KEHA Centre or the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment. Without an API key only the labelled example set is shown ({model}). Every other occupation stays unscored. Scoring runs only in a separate offline run, never in the browser and never in the Next.js API.
methodology.compositeTitle: How the labour-market outlook is composed
methodology.compositeBody: The public Työvoimabarometri interface returns kohtaanto for 19 regions, not a single national occupation-level index. The national state shown here is the employment-weighted majority of the regional matching states. The index is a weighted mean of the signed matching degree, where shortage is positive and surplus negative. This is a documented derivation, not a national figure published by KEHA.
methodology.staleBody: The most recent year of employment statistics in this extract is {year}, so employment is marked stale. If an occupation code is absent from the barometer or the employment table, the field is shown as missing. An unscored occupation is never given an invented value.
methodology.accessibilityBody: The default language is Finnish. Swedish and English use Statistics Finland's classification names, and the official descriptions are mostly in Finnish. The interface works with a keyboard, and the reduced-motion setting turns chart animations off.

analysis.methodologySummary: Official statistics and AI estimates stay separate. Missing data is labelled unavailable. A career change is not derived from exposure alone. AI-altistus ei tarkoita työpaikkojen katoamista.
analysis.stale: Some official inputs are stale or the score is old. This does not fill missing official numbers.
analysis.inferredSkills: Skills were normalised from task labels; they are not an explicit skill list.
analysis.fixture: Example estimate, not an official source.
analysis.noCapabilities: Transferable skills could not be normalised.
analysis.humanShare: Of the listed tasks, {human}/{total} are marked as human responsibility.
analysis.humanShareUnavailable: There is no task list for this occupation, so the share cannot be computed.
analysis.humanCoreNote: The share is computed from the AI-generated task list. It describes the distribution of that list, not how working time is spent and not whether a job is retained.

curated.title: Curated career path
curated.lead: A hand-written task set that complements the official statistics and the AI estimates. It is a third data class, not either of the previous two.
curated.notOfficial: This is neither official statistics nor the catalog's scoring, but an editorial expert assessment. It does not change the occupation's official figures or exposure scores.
curated.draftNotice: This set has not yet been validated by an expert panel. The values are a draft and are meant to be re-scored in panel.
curated.validatedNotice: A panel has reviewed this set. Reviewers: {count}.
curated.axesIndependent: The axes are independent. The same task can be high on both, and neither is the opposite of the other.
curated.staleAxis: The AI assessment is out of date and is due for re-review.
curated.axisReviewInterval: AI scores are re-reviewed every {months} months.
curated.noRenderableSources: No source anchoring the cards has been recorded yet. The available taxonomy reference is at site level only.
curated.contentLanguage: The card text is available in Finnish only.
curated.empty: There is no curated path for this occupation.
